name: corkboards
description: A customizable multi-column pinned note social feed reader and profile creator built on nostr. Zap bitcoin to creators and receive bitcoin for posts others find valuable.

scripts.//test: Full suite: every package, not just web. `test` used to alias test:web, which is why core had no type-check or lint coverage at all and mobile's jest/eslint never ran in a normal check. Core runs first so a shared-code break is reported at its source rather than as a confusing error inside an app.
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:web && npm run test:mobile
scripts.//test:desktop: Rust checks for the Tauri backend. Kept out of `test` because it needs a Rust toolchain, which the web/mobile contributor flow does not.
scripts.test:desktop: cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path packages/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @corkboards/core && npm run typecheck -w @corkboards/mobile && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @corkboards/core && npm run lint -w @corkboards/mobile && npm run lint -w @corkboards/web
